name: next-steps
description: After each answer, Claude's mascot reads it aloud (optional, local voice), asks how to continue and offers three next steps; a separate assistant helps you decide, and hands a request to the project only when you press a button.

language.title: Language
language.description: The language of the labels, the mascot's lines and the voice phrases: en (English) or it (Italiano). The suggested steps follow the language you write in.

assistantModel.title: Assistant model
assistantModel.description: The model of the separate assistant you talk to (Talk it over).

assistantEffort.title: Assistant effort
assistantEffort.description: How hard the assistant thinks before it answers: low, medium, high, xhigh or max.

assistantMaxTokens.title: Assistant reply cap
assistantMaxTokens.description: The most tokens one assistant reply may use (up to 64000).

voiceHome.title: Voice folder
voiceHome.description: The folder with the voice (venv and voices). Empty: .claude\voice in your user folder.
